reviews.title: Great purchase

reviews.title: MUST HAVE
reviews.body: These hangers are amazing! Not only are they super cute, but they're also excellent quality. They feel sturdy, hold my clothes securely, and instantly make my closet look more organized.Fun fact: I'm having my closet professionally designed, and I was told that using slim velvet hangers like these can help you fit up to three times more clothes in your closet compared to bulky plastic hangers. You're welcome! 😉I love that they save space while keeping clothes from slipping off. If you're looking to upgrade your closet and maximize storage, these hangers are definitely worth the purchase. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alyssa Show

reviews.title: Had to order more!
reviews.body: Such great hangers that save space and provide true non-slipping of clothing.  They came in handy as I got rid of ye old plastic hangers. My closet looks so much more organized and a little bit more spacious. They are lightweight and hold up very well. I did notice some hangers had "peeling" to them but I honestly didn't care since they are doing the work they are intended for.These are pretty versatile as I even have winter jackes hanging from them. The price is aslo very good in my opinion and on par with one of the big box companies my mom got hers from, but I like the fact that these come in various colors and finishes. The quantity options are also a blessing as I needed more than I initially opted for. Needless to say I liked them so much I had to order more. I also loved how well and neatly packed they came. 10/10 recommend!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 24, 2026
reviews.author: Trish

reviews.title: Slim, sturdy, no slipping
reviews.body: I love these hangers!  The velvet covering on them keeps clothes put, even silky items don’t fall off.  I like that they have a small dip on both sides to help keep spaghetti straps even more securely in place Because they aren’t bulky you can utilize your closet space better.  The metal hanger at the top also swivels which I find useful when hanging my clothes to steam.  Great quality and quantity for the price!
